settings.title: Partner With Barreletics
settings.body:
Bring Performance Skins to your studio or retail space. We work with studios, fitness retailers, and wellness centers to offer volume pricing on our patented grippy shoes.

Whether you're outfitting instructors or stocking retail shelves, we'll find the right arrangement for your business.
